TimeInterval.description: A span of time with a known start time, end time, and duration. As long as two of the three are known, the third can be inferred.
examples: 7pm to 9pm on Jan 1, 2001; fiscal year 2023 (according to some particular definition of fiscal year); the week starting at midnight of January 12, 2023 and lasting exactly 168 hours.
